Add command echoing and bye exit command
Add task storage and list display
commitResults.messageBody:
Store entered tasks sequentially, display them with numbering when
the list command is used, and prevent adding more than 100 tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce Task class for task state management

commitResults.messageBody:
Replace parallel task data arrays with Task objects.
Encapsulate task descriptions and completion status in Task,
including mark-as-done and mark-as-not-done behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Encapsulate Task fields with private visibility
commitResults.messageBody:
Hide Task implementation details and preserve controlled access
through the class's public methods.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task subclasses for todo, deadline, and event
Implement todo, deadline, event command parsing
Require UI test plan updates and test-ui execution
Add custom exception to handle invalid user input

commitResults.messageBody:
Refactor task storage from fixed-size array to ArrayList
so that tasks can be removed and remaining tasks can
be shifted automatically

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor task storage into TaskList class
Refactor command type detection into Parser
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds CommandType enum and centralizes command keyword detection in Parser,
reducing command-parsing logic in BingusDingus while preserving existing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract user interface output into Ui class
commitResults.messageBody:
Moves user-facing messages and display logic from BingusDingus into a
dedicated Ui class, improving separation of responsibilities while
preserving existing behaviour

commitResults.messageTitle: Persist task list changes to disk
Load saved tasks when the application starts
Harden task persistence and input handling
Add date and time support for deadlines and events
Update README date and time documentation
Organise classes into suitable Java packages
Add JUnit tests for task management behaviour
Refactor Java code to follow project standards
Add find command for task descriptions
Implement fully functional GUI with echo response
Validate event date ranges and null values
commitResults.messageBody:
Events currently accept invalid time ranges and null date/time values.
Reject these invalid states and convert malformed event commands into
InvalidTaskCommandException.

Find results currently restart numbering from one, which can cause
users to mark or delete the wrong task.

Preserve the original task indexes in search results so displayed
numbers remain valid for subsequent commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align Java code with SE-EDU standards
commitResults.messageBody:
The codebase contains missing Javadocs, formatting issues, and incomplete
documentation of the SE-EDU rules.

Update Java sources, Checkstyle configuration, coding-standard guidance, and
UI test expectations to enforce and reflect the complete conventions.

Task descriptions, event time ranges, task-list mutations, search indexes,
and date-only parsing rely on important internal assumptions. Document these
assumptions with Java assertions to detect programmer errors during
development and testing.

Parser.parseTask currently combines command dispatch, syntax validation,
task construction, and error translation, making it harder to read and extend.

Extract parsing for todo, deadline, and event commands into focused methods.
Preserve existing validation and error messages so behavior remains unchanged.

TaskList.parseStoredTask currently combines record validation, field normalization,
task construction, and status restoration, making the loading logic harder to follow.

Separate these responsibilities into focused helper methods.
Preserve the existing handling of valid and malformed storage records.

BingusDingus.getResponse currently mixes command dispatch, argument
extraction, and command-specific handling, making the flow harder to
follow.

Use a structured dispatcher and focused command helpers. Update the UI
test plan to reflect the application’s current invalid-command output.

Todo, Deadline, and Event duplicate the logic for displaying task
completion status, which can lead to inconsistent output over time.

Reuse Task.getStatusIcon() across all task types to keep status
formatting consistent.

The task marking handler mixes parsing, validation, state changes,
and response formatting, making its control flow harder to follow.

Extract focused helpers for these responsibilities while preserving
existing behavior and user-facing responses.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task persistence into dedicated class
commitResults.messageBody:
TaskList currently handles both task management and storage-format parsing,
which makes changes harder to isolate.

Move saving, loading, and stored-record parsing into TaskStorage so TaskList
can focus on managing tasks while preserving existing behavior.

Correct Javadoc formatting and lambda-expression line wrapping in production
and test code so the project conforms to its Checkstyle configuration.

Preserve all application behavior and test coverage.
Add assertions for task invariants
Improve code quality

commitResults.messageTitle: Add undo command for recent task changes
commitResults.messageBody:
Users currently cannot recover accidental add, delete, mark, or unmark
operations. Add one-step undo history with persistence-aware inverse
actions and clear the history after undo.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add storage and CLI formatting tests
commitResults.messageBody:
Expand automated coverage for task persistence,
malformed records, storage formats, empty lists,
task numbering, and CLI response messages.

Ignore malformed event ranges during storage loading so invalid
records do not prevent valid tasks from loading.

Commands with leading, trailing, repeated, or tab whitespace can be
interpreted inconsistently. Reject malformed spacing early and add
parser tests covering these invalid inputs.

The application currently accepts malformed commands,
invalid task data, duplicate tasks, and some storage
failures inconsistently. Validate these inputs and
report failures clearly while preserving valid saved data.

Missing deadline and event parameters should retain
their existing user-facing messages. Report the
duplicate-parameter error only when a parameter
appears more than once.

commitResults.messageTitle: Rename boolean variables according to convention

commitResults.messageBody:
TaskList repeats completion-state mutation, persistence,
and rollback logic across three public methods. This
duplication makes future changes harder to apply consistently.

Centralize the shared behavior in one private helper so all
completion updates preserve the same rollback semantics.

The command-line app can emit Unicode as '?' on legacy Windows
console encodings. Configure standard streams and Gradle runs to use
UTF-8 so the banner and future Unicode output remain intact.

TaskList duplicates save-and-rollback logic across add,
insert, and remove operations. This duplication makes
persistence behavior harder to maintain consistently.

Centralize the rollback handling in one helper so list
mutations share the same failure recovery behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Define constants for storage task types and status

commitResults.messageBody:
TaskList duplicates null and duplicate-task validation
in both add and insert. This duplication makes future
validation changes harder to maintain consistently.

Centralize the validation in one helper while preserving
operation-specific error messages.

BingusDingus duplicates the task-index bounds check
in the delete handler even though a shared validation
helper already exists.

Reuse the helper so mark and delete commands apply
consistent index validation.

BingusDingus duplicates completion-state checks, updates,
undo setup, and response handling for mark and unmark commands.

Centralize the shared behavior while preserving command-specific
messages and inverse undo actions.

Parser combines several whitespace rules in one dense boolean
expression, making the accepted input conditions difficult to read.

Separate the rules into named checks while preserving existing command
validation behavior.

Parser duplicates task-command prefix checks in command classification
and task construction, making the supported task commands harder to
maintain consistently.

Reuse one recognition helper so both parsing paths share the same
task-command definitions.

BingusDingus retains an obsolete argument-extraction method after
argument parsing was centralized in Parser.

Remove the dead method to keep the class free of redundant code.

Parser duplicates task-command prefix checks in command classification
and task construction, making command support harder to maintain.

Reuse one recognition helper so both parsing paths share the same
task-command definitions.

DateTimeParser duplicates the loop that tries supported formatters and
handles parse failures.

Reuse one helper for format iteration while preserving date-only
normalization and existing parsing behavior.

TaskList compares serialized task strings and uses a regular expression
to hide completion status, making duplicate detection difficult to
understand.

Move detail comparison into the task hierarchy and test subtype-specific
fields directly.

Ensure parser tests satisfy Checkstyle and correct the UI test
plan’s expected banner output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve JavaFX layout and input UX
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace the fixed AnchorPane layout with a responsive
BorderPane design, add consistent styling for the header,
conversation, and composer, and prevent blank submissions.

Remove the unnecessary user profile picture from
user messages and reduce the bot avatar size for
a cleaner conversation layout.

Set the JavaFX application window title for clearer
application identification.

Provide users with a concise command and date/time
reference when the GUI starts.
